title: Homeowner grant awareness and willingness to adopt heat pumps
abstract: An interview and survey study of homeowners assesses how grant awareness and initial installation costs influence willingness to purchase residential heat pumps.

title: Exergetic comparison of industrial ammonia heat pump compressors
abstract: Experimental tests compare compressor isentropic efficiency for industrial process heat pump installations and alternative refrigerants.

title: Behavioural factors in residential boiler replacement
abstract: Household interviews compare air-source heat pumps and gas boilers, and identify installer trust and upfront investment as drivers of household heating system choice.

title: Neural demand response of installed household heat pumps
abstract: A controller schedules existing household heat pumps to reduce electricity prices without studying household purchase or adoption decisions.
